title.zh: 允许正规士兵在完成规定训练后成为预备役军官、并被征召服现役者重新入伍，并在转回非现役身份时恢复原士官军衔
title.en: An Act to Permit Regular Enlisted Men Who Become Reserve Officers After the Prescribed Training and are Called to Active Duty as Reserve Officers to Reenlist and Regain Their Previous Noncommissioned Ranks Upon Their Reversion to Inactive Status
title.orig: An Act to Permit Regular Enlisted Men Who Become Reserve Officers After the Prescribed Training and are Called to Active Duty as Reserve Officers to Reenlist and Regain Their Previous Noncommissioned Ranks Upon Their Reversion to Inactive Status

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1954/ra_1064_1954.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Regular enlisted men, who become reserve officers after the prescribed officer training and are called to active duty as reserve officers, shall, within sixty days be permitted to reenlist and regain their previous non-commissioned ranks in the Regular Force upon their reversion to inactive status, if they so desire: Provided, That if such reserve officers complete at least two years of active commissioned service, they may be reenlisted in the grade next higher than the permanent enlisted grade previously held: Provided, further, That the privileges therein authorized shall not apply to officers who were reverted for cause: And Provided, finally, That the non-commissioned officers herein referred to shall not lose their reserve officer commissions.

The provisions of this Act shall apply to the enlisted men referred to in the preceding section who were reverted to inactive status before the approval of this Act: Provided, That they possess the necessary requirements for enlistment and are not over thirty-five years of age at the time they apply for reenlistment under this Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 12, 1954.
